verdict.rationale: Evidence shows llama.cpp's own GGUF quantization scheme (1.5–8-bit integer quantization) but no mention of loading external formats like FP8, INT4 (as a standalone scheme), GPTQ, or AWQ directly — llama.cpp requires models be converted to GGUF first, and no evidence pack item documents native GPTQ/AWQ/FP8 loading.
